theme: An open Sunday, with the Croatia clock ticking
greeting: The day is wide open, Dan — one 15-minute review with Mike this morning and nothing else on the calendar. What it surfaced, though, is a short stack of Croatia bookings that all have to clear before you fly out Sept 8.

needsAttention.title: Book the Cavtat night and the transfer
needsAttention.detail: The single night of Sept 19 in Cavtat and the noon Komolac-to-Cavtat transfer are still open (P1, was due Aug 26). Charter connectivity is poor, so both have to be booked from dry land before you leave on the 8th.

needsAttention.title: Lock the St Pete landing gap
needsAttention.detail: Sept 20-22 still has no lodging (P1, was due Aug 25) — you land TPA that Sunday but the kids aren't picked up until Tuesday. Close it before the trip takes you offline.

needsAttention.title: Confirm the checked bags in writing
needsAttention.detail: The issued ticket shows 0 checked bags. Pull the booking up on Eurowings Discover's site with the record locator, confirm the allowance there, and buy bags now if they aren't included — cheap now, costly at the counter (P1, was due Aug 25).

flagged.title: Nautilus Sailing balance due
flagged.detail: Invoice 2170, $6,475 for the Croatia course — a payment reminder landed Aug 29, and the course starts Sept 12.

inbox.noise: The usual NYT Cooking and WSJ digests, a Campo Grande promo, and a run of care.com sitter applications.
inbox.clear: The Nautilus course intro thread is friendly chatter — nobody's waiting on your reply.

recipe.title: Canal house year-round caprese salad
recipe.why: Late-summer tomatoes and basil are at their absolute peak right now, so a caprese asks for almost nothing else.

acts.line: The 9 AM board review with Mike is behind you — the Croatia list it surfaced is the day's real work.
A wide-open afternoon in St. Pete, best spent clearing the overdue bookings before the trip pulls you offline.
Room to cook and set a simple plan for tomorrow.
